label: Purpose of this SED
explanatoryNote: Choose the appropriate box for the reason of this document, e.g. box "reply to check or annual check" for ongoing cases, if there has been no change in circumstances in replying institution. If there has been change in circumstances for ongoing cases, choose the box "Information about change in circumstances". It is possible to choose more than one box. Reimbursement according to article 58 of Regulation (EC) No 987/2009 means that more than two countries are involved. For all other reimbursement claim(s) use R-SED(s).

label: Receipt of application for family benefits
explanatoryNote: Only to be filled if purpose of this SED is "Receipt of application for family benefits" or "Information about change in circumstances".

label: Date of receipt of the application
explanatoryNote: Mention the date when application or information about change in circumstances has received in this Member State.

label: Fixed Period
explanatoryNote: A period that has a known start and end date. The period may have already been completed or may still be to be completed.

label: Start date
explanatoryNote: Indicate the start date of the period.

label: End date
explanatoryNote: Indicate the end date of the period.

label: Open Period
explanatoryNote: A period which currently has no known end date.

label: Type of Open Period
explanatoryNote: The type "Open-Ended Period" is a period where the end date is not known and will not be known until it is completed, an example being a "period for which a person is unable to walk" The type "End date of the period is unknown" is a period where the period has ended but the end date is not known and cannot be provided.

label: Start date
explanatoryNote: Indicate the start date of the period.

label: Type of claim
explanatoryNote: Choose new claim if this is a new case for family benefit(s) otherwise choose change of circumstances.

label: Information on application
explanatoryNote: Choose the box concerned.

label: Points for which more information is needed
explanatoryNote: Mention here the points for requested additional information e.g. if you prefer information of amounts for benefits per child(ren) or total amount for entire family.

label: Information about change in circumstances
explanatoryNote: Only to be filled if purpose of this SED is "Information about change in circumstances". Choose the appropriate box. It is possible to choose more than one box if information is not about entire family.

label: Additional request or information

explanatoryNote: Although the PIN is optional it is strongly advised to add information in this section, not only for the receiving institution but also for the sending institution. explanatoryNote: For more information about the types and structure of the national Personal Identification Numbers (PINs) please refer to the Dictionary of Personal Identification Numbers which can be found on CircaBC.
